incidents.summary: Announced on 4 November. Attackers used compromised accounts; press reports put the amount at about $133 million, which the bank has not confirmed.

incidents.title: NSW Health: dental scheme website attacked
incidents.summary: Detected 29 October and reported 4 November. About 4 GB of data was exposed.

incidents.title: Gnosis Pay: legacy card system breached
incidents.summary: Card numbers, wallet addresses and personal data were exposed. The company says funds were not affected.

incidents.title: French blood service EFS: cold-room controls changed in attack
incidents.summary: The attack came through a refrigeration equipment provider and changed settings at three sites. No blood products were lost.

incidents.title: Inna: breach affects 16 schools in Iceland
incidents.summary: Reported to Iceland's data protection authority on 3 November. Assessment and health data were exposed.

incidents.title: Singapore Airlines: about 65,000 booking records affected
incidents.summary: The data was exposed through a breach at reservation provider Amadeus.

incidents.title: MoneySmart: customer data accessed
incidents.summary: Detected 29 October and reported 3 November. Names, IDs, contact details and policy numbers were exposed.

incidents.title: Turning Stone casinos forced to cash only after cyberattack
incidents.summary: The attack hit network and communications on 2 November. Casinos and convenience stores could only take cash.

incidents.title: CB Cloud: delivery platform PickGo accessed
incidents.summary: Detected 1 November. 164,180 customer-name records and some smaller data sets were exposed.

incidents.title: Sabcobel: remote attack forces supermarket refrigeration units into defrost
incidents.summary: About 20 units were pushed into defrost mode on 2 November, affecting 40 Ahold Delhaize and 15 Carrefour stores.

incidents.title: Osaka city government hit through email distribution service
incidents.summary: The 2 November attack on the provider hit nearly 400 of its customers and let attackers send fraudulent emails.

incidents.title: Wiping scripts destroy cloud data at Russian host Beget
incidents.summary: Ran on 1–2 November. Cloud data and virtual server backups were lost, the company says.

incidents.title: Attacker claims 30 GB stolen from Parle Agro
incidents.summary: Claim posted on a dark web forum on 1 November. Not verified.

incidents.title: Qilin lists Shibata Co. Ltd
incidents.summary: Leak-site listing on 1 November. Not confirmed by the company.

incidents.title: Interlock lists Assiniboine Dental Group
incidents.summary: Leak-site listing on 1 November. Not confirmed by the clinic.
